name: Maren
title: The Herbalist
examine: Makes the salve every axe hand in town swears by. Born in the out-camps the Wolfwinter emptied; carried inside the wall at four years old. She keeps a very small garden and a very long memory.
lines: Salve first. Whatever you came for, it is salve first. I have met woodcutters.
Sagewort forgives poor soil. Moonbell does not. People are one or the other too.
The garden is small because a garden should be finishable. Most things are not.
